description: Na₃CaMg₃AlF₁₄ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgF₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.60 Å. Ca is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are two shorter (2.20 Å) and six longer (2.48 Å) Ca-F bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form MgF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-49°. There are four shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Mg-F bond lengths. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgF₆ octahedra and edges with six equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 39°. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Ca atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Ca tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Ca, and two equivalent Mg atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNaCaMg₂ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Al atom.
